designed.domain_description: Rectangle [0,2] x [0,1]; left edge clamped, middle of the right edge loaded vertically, all remaining edges free.
designed.domain_description_rationale: Completed from the border-built mesh and the boundary conditions of the weak form.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_1
boundaries.definition: bottom edge y=0 (0<=x<=2), top edge y=1 (0<=x<=2) and the right edge segments x=2 with y in [0,0.45] and y in [0.55,1]
boundaries.rationale: Unloaded traction-free Neumann boundaries; the weak form loads only Gamma_N, so these are free and movable.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_N
boundaries.definition: boundary segment where the vertical load f is applied
boundaries.rationale: Loaded segment whose position is prescribed by the mesh, hence frozen even though it is Neumann.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_4
boundaries.rationale: Clamped edge with u=0; the Dirichlet boundary is fixed.

fields.name: u
fields.unit_rationale: Displacement is a length, in metres.
fields.dirichlet_labels_rationale: Gamma_4 is mesh label 4 (left edge); single Dirichlet value, so no penalty term is needed.

fields.name: u_tilde
fields.unit_rationale: Adjoint displacement, same physical dimension as u.
fields.dirichlet_labels_rationale: The adjoint state lies in V_delta_u, i.e. vanishes on label 4.

lagrangian.objective_description: Compliance plus material-volume functional J(u) = int_D ell*chi dx + int_D sigma(u):eps(u) dx.
lagrangian.state_description: u in V_u = {u in P2(D) | u = 0 on Gamma_4 (label 4)} solves the linear elasticity state equation; the loaded boundary is Gamma_N (label 2).
lagrangian.state_weak_form_rhs_rationale: The load integral is resolved to its concrete mesh label 2 (the middle right-edge segment).
lagrangian.adjoint_description: Find u_tilde in V_delta_u (u_tilde=0 on label 4) such that for all delta u in V_u:
lagrangian.adjoint_weak_form: \int_{D} \left( \pmb \sigma({\delta\mathbf u}) \mathrel{:} \pmb \varepsilon({\mathbf u}) + \pmb \sigma({\mathbf u}) \mathrel{:} \pmb \varepsilon({\delta\mathbf u}) \right) \,dx + \int_{D} \left( \raisebox{\depth}{$\chi$}\left(\lambda \mathbf I \operatorname{tr}(\pmb \varepsilon({\delta\mathbf u})) + 2\mu \pmb \varepsilon({\delta\mathbf u})\right) \mathrel{:} \nabla \tilde{\mathbf u} \right) \,dx = 0
lagrangian.adjoint_weak_form_rationale: Expanded from the source adjoint equation using the source definition of dsigma.
lagrangian.shape_derivative_rationale: Source formula with the boundary integrals resolved to mesh label 2.
lagrangian.penalty_used_rationale: Only one Dirichlet value (u=0 on label 4) is enforced, so no FreeFEM penalty workaround is required.
lagrangian.check_units_rationale: Default; all quantities carry consistent SI units.

optimization_config.hmin_rationale: Fine enough to resolve the 0.1-long loaded segment and the solid-void interface.
optimization_config.hmax_rationale: Coarser than the supplied n=60 mesh but adequate for a 2x1 domain.
optimization_config.diffusion_rationale: Mild level-set smoothing for a domain of size 2 without blurring the interface.
optimization_config.v0_rationale: Unit advection speed, the natural normalisation of the descent velocity field.
optimization_config.phi_rationale: Funnel template (wide at the clamped edge x=0, narrow at the loaded edge x=2), symmetric about y=0.5, covers the whole left edge and the loaded segment; ~65% initial solid fraction.
optimization_config.boundary_labels_rationale: The unloaded Neumann boundaries (label 1) are the movable design boundaries.
optimization_config.fixed_labels_rationale: Label 4 is clamped and label 2 carries the prescribed load, so both are frozen.
